method: Read-only platform DB query, followed by remote /proc/stat over two seconds and exit_code presence in each of this campaign's active run directories.
scheduler_observation: Current ExperimentOS Scheduler._reap iterates active_runs sequentially, invoking remote poll and then collect before _dispatch in the same tick.
interpretation: The platform running count includes completed jobs awaiting collection; it is not a count of simultaneously busy CPU cores.
scope: Operational snapshot only. Not a solver performance result or a claim about utilization throughout the experiment.
